hooks.command: f=$(grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/^"file_path":"//; s/"$//; s|\\\\|/|g'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py) uv run --project backend --no-sync ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.md) (cd frontend && npx --no-install prettier --write "$f") >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
[ -f backend/pyproject.toml ] || exit 0; cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy app
[ -f frontend/package.json ] || exit 0; cd frontend && npm run lint --if-present && npm run typecheck --if-present && npm run build --if-present
